thread:
Hana (SRE): We're repeatedly seeing similar DB connection storms every 6-10 weeks. I think the issue is follow-up hygiene — postmortem actions get lost. Can we agree on a tiny, enforceable follow-up template?
Tom - Infra: Yes. If follow-ups map to a ticket with an explicit owner and fallback, they're much less likely to vanish.
Becky PM: Agree. My wishlist: quick timeline fields, comms cadence, owner + fallback, and a recurrence check at ~60-90d.
Ravi Eng: Proposed minimal template (YAML/issue-friendly):
```
severity: P2
owner: <github-id>
fallback: oncall-rotation
immediate_mitigation: <short text>
short_deadline: 7d
long_deadline: 60d
qa_verify_by: <date>
recurrence_check: 90d
notes: <free text>
```
Hana (SRE): Love it. Also add `notified_channels` so we can control who gets pinged at each stage (owner only vs channel).
oncall-bot: Suggested automation: create followup-issue when PM labels a postmortem "remediation-required". Add 24h and 7d reminders to owner only.
Tom - Infra: Rotation: let's use a 2-week incident commander cadence published on the team calendar. Handoffs should be a 3-line summary: active incidents, open actions, blockers.
Becky PM: For comms cadence: ack internal within 30m, internal debrief within 24h, customer-facing update within 48-72h if applicable. We should store the 72h template centrally.
Ravi Eng: We should also auto-scan past 12 months for similar incident tags and attach links to the follow-up issue — helps pattern detection.
Hana (SRE): Action owners: Hana will draft the issue template and the oncall-bot rule (by Thu). Tom will publish rotation calendar and handoff snippet. Becky will assemble the 72h comms snippet. Ravi will wire the recurrence auto-linking query.
Becky PM: Quick decision: owners get direct pings; channel only on 72h or if escalation. :+1:
Ravi Eng: Minor: include `estimated_risk` field to help prioritize backlog.
Hana (SRE): Will add estimated_risk and a small checkbox list for "mitigation verified".
oncall-bot: Rule queued: postmortem->followup-issue, reminders (24h/7d/90d), owner-only pings by default.
Hana (SRE): Let's reconvene in next week's ops sync to review the draft and automation. If all good we'll flip the rule on.
Tom - Infra: Sounds good. thanks everyone.
Becky PM: Thanks! I'll create the Notion snippet for comms after the draft lands.
